data.body: Version-bump research (V1+V-workflow, validated live): a separate version-bump-on-merge GitHub Action keeps the version OFF feature branches (eliminates the conflict class). Net for S5: KEEP the version.file_path diff-scoped exemption (DD3a) as enforcement option B (version-only PR rides the process, exempt from coverage); the L6 semver-max rebase resolver is DROPPED (no longer needed). See docs/handoff/resilience-hardening-plan.md §9.
